original_description: Use this skill when the user wants to manage, inspect, create, promote, or organize their Claude Code agents. Triggers: "list my agents", "show agents", "create an agent", "promote agent to global", "copy agent", "what agents do I have", "agent manager", "level up", "manage agents", "move agent to global", "make this agent available everywhere". final_description: Use this skill when the user wants to list, find, promote, demote, move, copy, or create Claude Code agents. IMPORTANT: You cannot discover what agents exist across projects without this skill â€” it contains scanner scripts that search all .claude/agents/ directories across every project and global scope. Also use for creating new agent .md files. Do NOT use for: running agents, debugging agent errors, or explaining what agents are.
